description.text: Extra Regulation Box (BW/XY), sold at Pokémon Card Gym stores from 4 October 2019 for players who had started with recent series but wanted to play the Extra format, ahead of the first Extra Battle Day. Its 201 cards of 57 kinds are all non-holo: 93 cards of 48 kinds from the Black & White and XY series, already out of the Standard format, such as Shaymin-EX, M Rayquaza-EX and Computer Search, and 108 basic Energy in the Black & White design. Sleeves and a card box came with it.
